title: Senior asks: CsvFileActions::read() checks the column count before array_combine(). What does PHP 8 do without that check?
options: array_combine() throws a ValueError, so the user gets a 500
It fills the missing value with null
explain: Since PHP 8, array_combine() throws ValueError when the two arrays have different sizes. Nobody catches it, so the API would answer 500. The own check turns it into a clear 422 message about the bad row.

title: Senior asks: decodeJson() calls json_decode($text, true). What happens if someone removes the true?
options: The result is a stdClass object and $data['id'] throws an Error
Nothing, it still returns an array
explain: Without true, JSON objects become stdClass. Reading $data['id'] on an object throws 'Cannot use object of type stdClass as array'. The whole FileActions code expects arrays, so the second argument must stay true.

title: Senior asks: a user saves {} (an empty object) with write. JsonFileActions decodes and encodes it. What is in the file?
explain: With true, {} becomes an empty PHP array. An empty array has no keys, so json_encode writes [] . The object turns into a list. The data changes shape. If this matters, use JSON_FORCE_OBJECT or keep the raw text.

title: Senior asks: composer.json has "php": ">=8.4". The server runs PHP 8.2. What does composer install do?
options: It stops with an error: your PHP version does not satisfy the requirement
It installs and the app runs with warnings
explain: Composer checks the php requirement as a platform package. PHP 8.2 does not match >=8.4, so it fails at install time. That is good: you find out on deploy, not at runtime. Update PHP on the server or lower the constraint on purpose.

title: PHP 8. round() with halves. What does this print?
explain: PHP round() rounds .5 away from zero: 2.5 gives 3 and -2.5 gives -3. This is not bankers' rounding. Python does it differently. Check the language when money or counters depend on it.

title: What does Node print?
explain: Number('') is 0 and Number(null) is 0. Number('12px') is NaN, and Number(undefined) is NaN. An empty form field becomes 0, which can hide a missing value. Check for '' before converting.

title: PHP 8. Constructor promotion with named arguments. What does this print?
explain: Named argument y: 5 sets only y. x keeps its default 0. Promoted parameters become public properties, so $p->x and $p->y work. Named arguments let you skip the ones you do not need.

title: You forgot one file in your last commit. It is not pushed yet. What is the cleanest fix?
options: git add file, then git commit --amend --no-edit
explain: --amend adds the staged file to the last commit and --no-edit keeps the message. This is safe only while the commit is not pushed. After a push, make a new small commit instead.
